data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Vite is the name of a goddess of life and fertility. In the Bible, the name Vite is not explicitly mentioned, but it shares meaning with the Latin word 'vita' meaning 'life'. The name Vite carries the meaning “Life” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vite usually hope their child will grow to embody life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
